activation_rule: explicit user-authorized manual override of duration/count gates; all causal, parity, freshness, identity, policy, and row-local fail-closed gates remain mandatory
entry_order: market inside canonical 900-second decision window; candidate executability and accepted-entry state consume identical timestamp-exact decision_open and signal-time Wilder14 ATR lineage
entry_price_parity: pre-submit expected order-book VWAP and final fill must be no more than 50 adverse bps above the frozen decision-open price; a violating fill is immediately flattened and never committed
execution_adjusted_ev: raw frozen MC1_d2 expected net minus adverse live-midpoint gap since decision open minus only the live round-trip spread/order-book-impact proxy above the 100-bps cost already embedded in training; adjusted EV must remain at least +50 bps
execution_cost_components: current full bid/ask spread plus entry order-book impact for intended size; execution-delay gap is separate; favourable delay is not credited; no double application of the embedded 100-bps cost
preflight_rejection: row-local no-order rejection; post-order invariant failures remain fatal and fail closed
live_shadow_bridge_contract: actual-fill state plus exact predecessor hash; causal completed no-trade bars; observed decision-cell equality or official-hourly entry-open fallback
exit_replay_contract: independent frozen-bar replay from the exact hash-matched actual-fill bridge state used by the hourly run
